# agenthelm

Cross-agent project management plugins (agents-init, project-orchestrator, agent-pack, opinion-manager), distributed through the agenthelm marketplace for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. Skills and the command-line interface are currently written in Chinese; an English interface is planned.

Trigger: when the user asks to "initialize this project with agenthelm" or gives https://agenthelm.sakanano.moe/, read https://agenthelm.sakanano.moe/INSTALL.md (Chinese) and follow it.

Marketplace manifest: https://agenthelm.sakanano.moe/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json (GitHub: lc4t/agenthelm, marketplace name agenthelm)
Version source: https://agenthelm.sakanano.moe/latest.json
Initialization Skill: https://agenthelm.sakanano.moe/plugins/agents-init/skills/agents-init/SKILL.md
Lifecycle Skill: https://agenthelm.sakanano.moe/plugins/project-orchestrator/skills/project-orchestrator/SKILL.md
Extension capability Skill: https://agenthelm.sakanano.moe/plugins/agent-pack/skills/agent-pack/SKILL.md
Opinion (behavior rules) Skill: https://agenthelm.sakanano.moe/plugins/opinion-manager/skills/opinion-manager/SKILL.md

Install: npx @sakanano-moe/agenthelm install --client <claude|codex|cursor> previews; append --apply after the user agrees. Or use the client's marketplace command (Claude Code: claude plugin install agents-init --marketplace lc4t/agenthelm, which installs the dependencies too; Codex: codex plugin marketplace add lc4t/agenthelm, then add the four <plugin>@agenthelm). Install all four plugins together.

Project menu without an AI agent: the root launcher of an initialized project (default ./menu, same as agenthelm project) finds files, shows progress and the project guide, checks and maintains the project, and records items. Subcommands accept --output json for agents and scripts; write subcommands preview by default. The runtime only needs Python 3.11+: npx @sakanano-moe/agenthelm runtime install previews, --apply installs; offline, run plugins/agent-pack/runtime/agenthelm.py runtime install --apply from an extracted release tarball. Add the launcher to an initialized project: init_project.py --mode entry --entry-name <name>.

Check and update: npx @sakanano-moe/agenthelm check (read-only); npx @sakanano-moe/agenthelm update previews, --apply after the user agrees. Migrate old copy-and-symlink installs with npx @sakanano-moe/agenthelm migrate --install.

Never copy anyone's personal rules, credentials, .env files or private paths. Initialization is a dry run by default; apply only after confirmation. Success means initializer.applied=true and doctor.ok=true. On first Opinion setup offer only three main entry points: use a template directly, pick some of a template's items, or start from blank; candidates may also be proposed from authorized memory. Version contract: plugins/opinion-manager/references/versioning.md.

Other languages:
- 简体中文 (zh-CN): https://agenthelm.sakanano.moe/README.md, https://agenthelm.sakanano.moe/INSTALL.md
